title: Code and per-sample results: Jev versus a reasoning LLM for structured clinical record classification
description: Code and per-sample derived results for a paired comparison of a typed decision model (Jev) and reasoning LLMs on three structured clinical classification tasks. No source clinical records or input text are included.

creators.name: Zhou, Shengzhe
creators.affiliation: Faculty of Computer Science and Technology, Qilu University of Technology, Jinan, Shandong, China

notes: DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23838134. Source clinical data are not redistributed; only derived per-sample fields and code are included.
